THE JOURNEY BEHIND THE ACTOR

Every Dream Has A Story

Every performance is shaped by experiences, challenges and an unwavering passion for cinema.

The Dream That Was Deleted... But Never Destroyed.

My journey began with mono acting, stage performances, drama and mime. Storytelling wasn't just a hobby—it became the way I expressed myself.

During my college days, I wrote and directed a short film with the support of my classmates and teachers. Although that project was later lost, the dream of becoming an actor and filmmaker never disappeared.

The Beginning

Discovering the Stage

My journey started with mono acting, drama, mime and storytelling. These early experiences built my confidence and taught me how to connect with an audience through emotion.

College

First Step into Filmmaking

I wrote and directed my first short film with the support of classmates and teachers. Even though the project was later lost, the passion to create stories continued to grow.
